about.title: About Allo Infirmier
about.subtitle: Our mission: making home nursing care accessible
about.mission_text: Allo Infirmier is a home nursing coordination agency based in Rabat and Salé. We do not provide medical acts directly — we coordinate and connect patients with licensed and certified nurses.
about.vision_text: To become the go-to reference for home care coordination in Morocco, offering a premium, accessible and multilingual service to all families, expats and tourists.
about.network_text: Our network consists exclusively of state-certified, verified and experienced nurses. Each practitioner is evaluated according to strict criteria of professionalism, punctuality and quality of care.
about.quality_text: Patient safety is our absolute priority. All our practitioners follow current medical protocols and use sterile equipment. We provide follow-up after every intervention.

services_faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about our services

items.q: Can I request the same nurse for regular follow-up?
items.a: Yes, we do our best to ensure continuity of care with the same professional.

items.q: Do I need to provide medical supplies?
items.a: No, our nurses bring all necessary supplies. If specific equipment is required, we'll inform you in advance.

items.q: Can I cancel or reschedule an appointment?
items.a: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 2 hours before the scheduled intervention.
